id.description: The ID of the provider. Corresponds to the ID received from the Capabilities API.

mode.description: Preferred urgency of the payment. This preference will be honored if the provider supports it, but it may be ignored - some providers pick the mode automatically. If INSTANT is preferred but isn't possible for the payment, STANDARD will be used as a fallback.

feePaidBy.description: Preferred distribution of the transaction fees. Mostly irrelevant for SEPA Standard payments, but could be used for SEPA Instant in certain markets if charging (higher than standard) fees for instant payments is allowed there

number.description: Sender's account number data. If not provided, the PSU will either be able to select the account in the UI of the provider (if possible), or we will perform an AIS request to the provider and prompt the PSU to select an account.

currency.description: Sender's account currency. If not provided, the PSU will either be able to select the account in the UI of the provider (if possible), or we will perform an AIS request to the provider and prompt the PSU to select an account.

buildingNumber.description: Building and apartment/office/suite number of the address.

id.description: Sender's login id in the provider's system. If not provided, the PSU will be able to enter it during the payment process.

password.description: Sender's password in the provider's system. If not provided, the PSU will be able to enter it during the payment process.

account.description: Sender's account data. If not provided, the PSU will be able to select the account during the payment initiation process.

number.description: Sender's account number data. If not provided, the PSU will either be able to select the account in the UI of the provider (if possible), or we will perform an AIS request to the provider and prompt the PSU to select an account.

truncate.description: If set to true, remittance information value will be truncated to fit the specified provider's requirements. If false or not provided, the value will be returned as is, and may cause errors if it exceeds provider limits.

value.description: Remittance information value. Maximum length depends on the payment scheme (140 characters for SEPA). Only alphanumeric characters and these special characters are allowed: / + - [space].

redirectUri.description: The URI to which the PSU will be redirected once the payment flow is completed.

psuIpAddress.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address of the PSU. Required by providers. IPv4 must be a full four-octet IP address, e.g. 84.240.80.120. IPv6 must be expanded to eight segments without the `::` shorthand.

webhookUrl.description: The URL where you want to receive a webhook when the payment status changes. Must be a valid HTTPS URL.
